slot.brief: Give the formula of a mixed-ligand coordination compound; pick the correct IUPAC name with proper ligand order, oxidation-state notation and geometric prefixes.

stem: What is the correct IUPAC name of cis-$[\text{CoCl}_2(\text{en})_2]\text{Cl}$, where en is ethane-1,2-diamine?

verdicts.working: en is neutral and the two chlorido ligands contribute −2. Since the complex ion has charge +1, cobalt is +3. The cis complex is named cis-dichloridobis(ethane-1,2-diamine)cobalt(III) chloride.

working:
Complex charge $=+1$: $x+2(-1)=+1$, hence Co is $+3$.\nLigand order: chlorido before ethane-1,2-diamine; use bis for the bidentate ligand.\nThe formula specifies cis geometry; the counter-ion is chloride.

Independent check: en is neutral and the two chlorido ligands contribute −2. Since the complex ion has charge +1, cobalt is +3. The cis complex is named cis-dichloridobis(ethane-1,2-diamine)cobalt(III) chloride.
solution:
The complex ion has charge $+1$; if cobalt has oxidation state $x$, then $x+2(-1)=+1$, so $x=+3$.
The ligands are named chlorido before ethane-1,2-diamine, using $bis$ for the bidentate ligand; the given geometry is cis.
Thus, the name is cis-dichloridobis(ethane-1,2-diamine)cobalt(III) chloride.
